name: Mandarin Oriental Santiago
insider_take: This luxury oasis sits in Santiago's prestigious Las Condes district, where the Andes Mountains create a breathtaking backdrop for Chile's most sophisticated hotel experience.
whats_special: The hotel occupies floors 3-23 of a striking glass tower, offering unparalleled panoramic views of the snow-capped Cordillera. Its location puts you steps from Chile's financial heart and world-class shopping at Parque Arauco mall. The property features Santiago's only hotel spa with traditional Asian treatments and houses one of the city's most acclaimed restaurants.
pro_tip: Request a room on floors 15+ facing east for the most spectacular Andes sunrise views, especially dramatic during winter months when the peaks are snow-covered.
dont_miss: The rooftop pool with 360-degree city and mountain vistas, and dinner at Matsuri restaurant for exceptional Japanese cuisine with a Chilean twist. Take advantage of the hotel's proximity to Cerro San Cristóbal - just 15 minutes away for sunset views over the entire Santiago valley.
pros: Prime location in Las Condes business district with stunning Andes mountain views
Exceptional spa and wellness facilities with traditional Asian treatments
Award-winning restaurants featuring innovative Chilean and international cuisine
Impeccable service standards consistent with Mandarin Oriental luxury hospitality
cons: Business district location may feel less culturally immersive
